In this video, we will explore the
View menu hotkey sequences

as well as basic navigation
using the mouse and keyboard.
With the schematic as the active document,
select the View menu.

Here, there are several commands that quickly
adjust the view of the design space.

Fit Document
will fit the entire document outline
within the design space.

Fit All Objects
will zoom to fit all objects

within the active document
to the design space.
Selecting View, then Area

will zoom to fit an area
within a drawn rectangle.

There are also options
to zoom to selected objects,

simply zoom in or out incrementally,
or enter full screen mode.
Navigation with the mouse and keyboard
is similar to other Windows environments.

Click the right mouse button
to activate the panning hand.

Press and hold the ‘Ctrl’ key
along with the right mouse button
to zoom in and out.

Another easy way to pan
is using the middle mouse wheel.

Scroll the middle mouse wheel
to move up and down
within the active document.

Press and hold the ‘Ctrl’ key
while using the middle mouse wheel
to zoom in and out.

Press and hold the ‘Shift’ key
while using the middle mouse wheel
to pan left and right.

On the keyboard, you can use
the ‘Page Up’ and ‘Page Down’ keys
to zoom in and out.

Press and hold the ‘Ctrl’ key
while pressing ‘Page Down’
to fit all objects.

Press the ‘Home’ key
to recenter the document
on the cursor location.

Use the ‘Arrow’ keys
to move the cursor one grid step at a time.
Or use ‘Shift + Arrow’ keys
to move the cursor ten steps at a time.

In this video,
we explored the View menu hotkey sequences

as well as basic navigation
using the mouse and keyboard.

title: Altium Training - Design Environment: Navigation with Schematic Workspace
